HCJB Voice of Andes FAQ

What frequency is HCJB Voice of Andes on?
In the A-26 season HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled on 6 shortwave frequencies, including 3995, 5920, 6050, 7365, 9500, 11700 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 5920 kHz (8 pm – 9 pm Eastern). For Europe: 5920 kHz (5 am – 11 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear HCJB Voice of Andes in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 5920 kHz (8 pm – 9 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does HCJB Voice of Andes broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled in German, Russian, Spanish, D-P, COF.

Is HCJB Voice of Andes on the air right now?
As of Saturday, October 10, 2026, 11:10 UTC, HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled to be broadcasting on 3995 kHz to C. Europe. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
